counterexample.mechanism: The merged runtime bridge verifies _runtime_profile_snapshot, strips it to compare persisted profile bytes, and then passes the stripped stored profile to the canonical compositor. The canonical compositor calls mini_inference_capability_binding_v1.resolve_bound_route -> resolve_from_profile, which requires _runtime_profile_snapshot. Therefore the real cross-module path is structurally capable of failing with PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_MISSING even though the bridge's RecordingCompositor test passes.
counterexample.test_blindspot: The merged bridge regression injects RecordingCompositor and explicitly asserts _runtime_profile_snapshot is absent, so it does not exercise the downstream real capability resolver requirement.

repair.mechanism: After exact active-profile byte/hash equality succeeds, reconstruct only the runtime snapshot from verified MiniUnifiedDB active_profile + profile_sha256 and pass that verified ephemeral field into the single canonical compositor. No caller-supplied J-Space/model/capability authority is added.
repair.regression_strengthening: The success-path RecordingCompositor now calls the real mini_inference_capability_binding_v1.resolve_from_profile on the delegated profile, requiring the read->capability snapshot continuity fence to survive.

authority.profile_snapshot_authority: verified MiniUnifiedDB active profile id + persisted-byte hash only
